title: ManagedRoute: identity (UID) is separate from the name echoed to callers
answers: Why does the routing tree API echo a different name than the UID?
How do I support a legacy alias for a resource name without breaking RBAC scopes?
Default routing tree alias response shows wrong/changed name
Route response ObjectMeta.Name doesn't match what I expect
body:
Symptom: API response for a resource that supports a legacy name alias (e.g. the default routing tree's 'user-defined' alias) either loses the alias in the response or diverges in RBAC scope depending on which name was used to address it.
Root cause: previously ManagedRoute.Name conflated stable identity and caller-facing display name; GetUID() re-canonicalized r.Name on every call (old pkg/services/ngalert/notifier/legacy_storage/v1/routes.go GetUID).
Fix pattern: keep only the canonical identity on the domain model (ResourceMetadata.UID), and pass the caller's requested display name explicitly at the k8s conversion/edge-API boundary instead of storing it on the service-level model.
Constraints: applies to resources that must support an alias resolving to the same underlying object while echoing the caller's spelling back in metadata.name; not needed for resources without alias ambiguity.
says: Why does the routing tree API response show a different resource name?
How do I support legacy aliases for resource names in the API?
Route API response echoes a name different from the requested one
Default routing tree response uses an unexpected alias for the resource
Resource identity should be separate from the display name in responses
search: ManagedRoute must separate stable identity (ResourceMetadata.UID) from caller-facing display name to prevent API response divergence and RBAC scope inconsistencies. Keep canonical identity on the domain model; pass the caller's requested name spelling explicitly at the k8s conversion and edge-API boundary (pkg/registry/apps/alerting/notifications/routingtree/conversions.go:ConvertToK8sResource, pkg/services/ngalert/notifier/legacy_storage/v1/routes.go:ManagedRoute, GetUID). This applies only to resources supporting alias resolution (e.g., the 'user-defined' alias) that must echo the caller's spelling in response metadata while maintaining a single underlying identity. Conflating Name with both identity and display name causes the legacy GetUID() re-canonicalization to lose the alias in responses or create RBAC divergence depending on which name addressed the resource. Relevant for routingtree and legacy_storage/v1 ManagedRoute handling.
